images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: homepage hero photograph for a free WordPress Home Services starter. Create an original editorial photograph of a tidy practical residential renovation workspace: an oak workbench with a well-used cordless drill, tape measure, neatly arranged hand tools and wood shavings, with a softly focused bright lived-in home hallway behind. No people, no brands or text, no watermark, no collage. Warm natural daylight, muted navy and warm wood tones, credible small local repair business rather than luxury property. Landscape 4:3, main tools central and visible when cropped on a phone, natural photographic detail.

No people, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, no collage. Soft morning sunlight, fresh but believable lived-in home, muted teal and soft cream colors, no exaggerated sparkles. Landscape 4:3, caddy and clean surfaces centered for mobile cropping.
